fr_html: M. HAGERUP, de sa part, dit que l'Académie de 1913 non seulement existe, mais est munie d'un curatorium, dont il est membre. Dans ces circonstances, on devra se borner à recommander que l'Académie soit mise en activité.
en_html: M. HAGERUP, for his part, said that the Academy of 1913 not only existed, but possessed a Governing Body of which he was a member. Under these circumstances they should confine themselves to a recommendation to the effect that the existing Academy should be set in operation.
